close_reason: Migrated 7 UTCDate fields in jmap-filenode-types from Option<String> to Option<UTCDate>: FileNode::changed (filenode.rs:245) and 6 filter bounds (created_before/_after, modified_before/_after, accessed_before/_after in filter.rs:84-104). Updated 7 test fixtures in tests/filenode_types.rs to construct via UTCDate::from. Wire format unchanged. Downstream jmap-filenode-server and jmap-filenode-client compile and tests pass. Clippy -D warnings and rustdoc -D warnings clean.
description:
Audit follow-up from JMAP-g7wu.9.5. JMAP-g7wu.9.2 migrated FileNode::{created, modified, accessed} to Option<UTCDate> but missed 7 sibling fields that are also documented as UTCDate.

Sites (all in crate-jmap-filenode-types/src/):

filenode.rs:
1. line 245 — FileNode::changed: Option<String>  (doc says 'The date the server last recorded a change to any property (server-set)' — sibling of already-migrated created/modified/accessed)

filter.rs (all 6 documented 'this UTCDate'):
2. line 84  — FileNodeFilterCondition::created_before: Option<String>
3. line 88  — FileNodeFilterCondition::created_after: Option<String>
4. line 92  — FileNodeFilterCondition::modified_before: Option<String>
5. line 96  — FileNodeFilterCondition::modified_after: Option<String>
6. line 100 — FileNodeFilterCondition::accessed_before: Option<String>
7. line 104 — FileNodeFilterCondition::accessed_after: Option<String>

Change:
  Option<String> -> Option<UTCDate>

This consistency gap was explicitly called out in JMAP-g7wu.9.5's bd comment from the .9.2 implementer.

API break — 0.2.0 class. Coordinate with sibling beads (calendars-types, tasks-types, contacts-types) per workspace cookie-cutter rule.

Test approach: update any RFC-example fixture tests to construct UTCDate via UTCDate::new_validated() or UTCDate::from() — wire JSON unchanged because UTCDate is a transparent newtype around String.

Acceptance:
- cargo test -p jmap-filenode-types passes.
- cargo clippy -p jmap-filenode-types -- -D warnings clean.
- All 7 fields use Option<UTCDate>.
- Downstream jmap-filenode-server and jmap-filenode-client still compile.
- RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc -p jmap-filenode-types --no-deps clean.
title: UTCDate migration in jmap-filenode-types follow-up: changed field + 6 filter bounds
